summary: AquaBounty Technologies filed an 8-K reporting that its Board decided not to implement a previously authorized reverse stock split (ratio 1-for-5 to 1-for-20) after stockholder approval at the June 23, 2026 annual meeting. The Board concluded the split was not in the best interests of the company or its stockholders, and the authorization will expire on July 31, 2026 without action. No terms such as price, premium, or definitive event are present. This is a routine board resolution regarding a potential capital structure adjustment, not a standalone special situation. Filers should watch for any future stockholder solicitation or Nasdaq compliance needs.
